description.value: The study evaluated automated MRI quantification methods and the Disease State Index classifier for differential diagnosis of bvFTD from AD, LBD, FTLD, and SMC, including comparison by C9ORF72 expansion status.

spans.text: The aim of this study was to evaluate the utility of the DSI using data from MRI scans only in a setting of differentiating bvFTD from AD, FTLD, Lewy body dementia (LBD) and subjective memory complaints (SMC).

description.value: Retrospective observational diagnostic classification study using MRI scans from bvFTD patients and independent reference data.

spans.text: For this study, the scans were retrospectively collected from the patient data archive.
